name: Cricket frenzy VR
summary:
Experience the thrill of cricket like never before in VR Cricket Multiplayer! Dive into the immersive world of virtual cricket, where you can play in fast-paced matches, practice your batting and bowling, and compete with players from around the world.

Key Features:

Multiplayer Action: Play with friends or compete against players globally in real-time multiplayer matches.
Realistic Gameplay: Bat, bowl, and field with realistic physics and responsive controls that bring the sport to life.
